title: Zayan and the Shifting School
logline: When an experimental school security system turns the hallways into a rapidly shifting maze, a nine-year-old boy with ADHD must use his fast-pattern recognition to guide his teacher and classmate to safety.

beats.title: The Quest for the Glow-Ball
beats.summary: Zayan sprints across the school playground to release his hyperactive energy, determined to sneak back inside to retrieve his favorite glowing bounce-ball from the science storage closet before the weekend.
beats.trait_in_play: Zayan uses intense physical activity (running, cartwheels) to manage his hyperactive energy levels, showing his constant need for movement.

beats.title: The Locker Obstacle
beats.summary: Inside the school, Zayan struggles to remember his simple locker combination. He uses his rubber band totem to ground himself and recall the numbers.
beats.trait_in_play: Zayan experiences short-term memory challenges, a common aspect of his ADHD, and uses a physical sensory anchor (snapping his rubber band) to focus.

beats.title: The Security Glitch
beats.summary: Just as Zayan meets Mr. Henderson and Leo in the hallway, the school's high-tech security system glitches, transforming the linear corridors into a shifting maze.
beats.trait_in_play: Zayan is highly alert to the changing environment, noticing details that others miss when the emergency begins.

beats.title: Trapped in the Maze
beats.summary: The group realizes they are locked inside. Leo tries to map the corridors, but the walls shift too quickly, rendering traditional linear mapping completely useless.
beats.trait_in_play: Zayan remains calm under pressure, his brain already beginning to track the timing of the shifting walls.

beats.title: The Thirty-Second Rule
beats.summary: Zayan identifies the pattern: the walls shift exactly every thirty seconds. He takes the lead, confident he can navigate the windows of opportunity.
beats.trait_in_play: Zayan's rapid pattern recognition allows him to see the timing behind the chaotic shifting of the maze.

beats.title: Not a Superpower
beats.summary: When Leo praises Zayan's fast brain as a superpower, Zayan explicitly explains how exhausting and challenging having ADHD actually is in daily life.
beats.trait_in_play: Zayan openly discusses the realities of attention deficit hyperactivity disorder, qualifying that his brain's speed comes with real struggles.

beats.title: Navigating the Pulses
beats.summary: Zayan guides the group through the first major wall shift by observing the subtle visual cues of the floor lights.
beats.trait_in_play: Zayan's brain tracks multiple environmental possibilities at once, picking the safe corridor before it even opens.

beats.title: The Vault Chamber
beats.summary: They reach the central vault where the exit is blocked by three rapidly spinning concentric metal rings.
beats.trait_in_play: Zayan uses his focus to calculate the complex rotational overlapping of the three separate rings.

beats.title: The Ultimate Leap
beats.summary: Zayan quickly climbs to retrieve his glowing bounce-ball, then coordinates a synchronized sprint through the tiny two-second opening in the spinning rings.
beats.trait_in_play: Zayan's fearlessness and ability to compute multiple moving parts simultaneously allow him to execute the escape plan perfectly.

beats.title: Back to the Playground
beats.summary: The group bursts out onto the safe playground just as the school locks down. Zayan celebrates getting his ball and immediately starts running laps to burn off remaining energy.
beats.trait_in_play: Zayan continues to have ADHD, bouncing his ball and running, showing that his neurodivergence is a permanent, integrated part of who he is.

trait_causality_note: Zayan's ADHD allows him to process multiple shifting corridor pathways and overlapping rotational ring cycles simultaneously, a feat impossible for the neurotypical characters who can only focus on one linear path at a time.
